fastpeoplesearch.evidence: Homepage form id form-search-name has a required name box (id search-name-name, placeholder "e.g John Doe") and a combined "City & State, or Zip" box. Its action is /search, but the site's app.js cancels that submit and opens /name/<name slug>, adding _<location slug> when the location box is filled. The stored GET /search?name=John+Smith answers 404, so Frame's search never reached a results page. url_pattern stores the name-only path; the two controls are the path's parts, not page control names. The location variant is not stored: Frame drops a path segment it cannot fill completely, and a person without a city would then get no name either.
